verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing natively automates recurring payment jobs (subscriptions, invoicing, trials, renewals, smart retries) and this can be driven via API/MCP by an AI agent, plus Stripe Projects/CLI/Workbench let agents script and schedule integration tasks. However there is no evidence of a general-purpose 'schedule any workflow/job' primitive (e.g. cron-like task scheduler for arbitrary agent workflows) beyond payment/billing-specific recurrence. missing for 10: a generic workflow/job scheduler beyond billing recurrence, evidence of agents autonomously scheduling multi-step workflows (not just recurring payments), independent hands-on confirmation of this automation depth.
